title: TMS-EEG correlate of suicidal ideation in individuals with depression: A multi-site synthesis
title_zh: TMS-EEG 与抑郁症患者自杀意念的相关性：多中心综合研究
abstract: BACKGROUND: Suicidal ideation (SI) is a leading risk factor for suicide death, with a lifetime prevalence of 35-40% in psychiatric populations. However, the neurobiology of SI remains poorly understood. Preliminary work suggests an association between SI and neurophysiological measures derived from transcranial magnetic stimulation combined with electroencephalography (TMS-EEG). METHODS: This study aims to test the association between SI and two TMS-EEG measures: the negative peak at 100 ms (N100) and the area under the curve (AUC) of the global mean field amplitude (GMFA). In this multi-site data synthesis, cross-sectional TMS-EEG data from 299 adult participants with major depressive disorder and at least 1 ineffective antidepressant trial were aggregated across five academic medical centers. Single-pulse TMS was delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) with simultaneous EEG recording. RESULTS: The N100 peak amplitude between 80 and 130 ms, as well as the AUC-GMFA between 55 and 275 ms, were extracted for each participant. Ordinal regression analysis revealed a significant positive association between more negative N100 peak amplitude in the left DLPFC and greater severity of SI (OR = 1.52, p = 0.002, 95%CI [1.17; 1.98]), independent of age, sex, depression severity, and study site. There was no significant association between GMFA and SI. CONCLUSION: N100 peak amplitude in the left DLPFC is a neurophysiological correlate of SI which may reflect a neurophysiological link between GABAergic inhibitory dysregulation and the pathophysiology of SI. Further research is needed to validate these findings using sham TMS-EEG and subsequently test the utility of N100 in the left DLPFC as a biomarker of SI and a possible treatment target.
abstract_zh: 背景：自杀意念（SI）是导致自杀死亡的主要风险因素，在精神病人群中终生患病率为35-40%。然而，SI 的神经生物学机制尚不清楚。初步研究表明，SI 与经颅磁刺激结合脑电图（TMS‑EEG）得到的神经生理指标之间存在关联。方法：本研究旨在检验 SI 与两项 TMS‑EEG 指标的关联：100 ms 负峰（N100）和全局平均场幅度（GMFA）的曲线下面积（AUC）。在这项多中心数据综合研究中，收集了299名患有重性抑郁障碍且至少经历过一次无效抗抑郁药治疗的成年参与者的横断面 TMS‑EEG 数据，数据来自五家学术医疗中心。单脉冲 TMS 作用于左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC），同时记录 EEG。结果：提取了每位参与者在80–130 ms 之间的 N100 峰幅度以及55–275 ms 之间的 AUC‑GMFA。序数回归分析显示，左侧 DLPFC 的 N100 峰幅度越负，SI 的严重程度越高（OR = 1.52，p = 0.002，95% CI [1.17; 1.98]），该关联与年龄、性别、抑郁严重程度和研究地点无关。GMFA 与 SI 之间无显著关联。结论：左侧 DLPFC 的 N100 峰幅度是 SI 的神经生理相关指标，可能反映 GABA 能性抑制失调与 SI 病理生理之间的神经生理联系。需要进一步研究以使用安慰剂 TMS‑EEG 验证这些发现，并随后评估左侧 DLPFC N100 作为 SI 生物标志物和潜在治疗靶点的实用性。
